title: 社区关系
summary: 评估公司与运营所在社区的关系管理，包括社区影响、许可与社会冲突。

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Community Relations Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Community Relations is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their management of local community relations and policies on human rights.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍社区关系关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。社区关系属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖当地社区关系管理及人权政策。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: \- Operational disruptions or loss of market access due to community opposition.
blocks.content_cn: • 因社区反对而导致运营中断或丧失市场准入。

blocks.content: \- Loss of formal and social license to operate.
blocks.content_cn: • 丧失正式运营许可及社会认可。

blocks.content: • Litigation by landowners and other affected parties.
blocks.content_cn: • 土地所有者和其他受影响方提起诉讼。

sections.title_cn: 社区关系关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Community Relations Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue Score.
blocks.content_cn: 社区关系关键议题得分评估公司对该议题风险的敞口程度及管理情况。该关键议题得分根据下述公式，基于风险敞口得分和管理得分计算。两项得分的结合方式意味着：风险敞口越高，公司就需要展现越强的管理能力，才能取得相同的总体关键议题得分。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

blocks.content: The Community Relations Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

sections.title_en: • Commitment to refrain from operating in protected areas.

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether a company has made a commitment to avoid operating in high-conservation areas, such as World Heritage sites or areas of cultural significance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否承诺避免在世界遗产地或具有文化重要性的区域等高保护价值地区运营。

sections.title_en: - Company conducts community impact assessment prior to settling in new areas.
sections.title_cn: • 公司在进入新地区前开展社区影响评估。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether a company conducts community impact assessments in line with the principles of Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) or whether there is any evidence of community engagement prior to developing in new areas.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否按照自由、事先和知情同意原则开展社区影响评估，或是否有证据显示其在新地区开发前已与社区沟通。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has a policy to minimize community impacts on indigenous people and their traditional way of life.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否制定政策，尽量减少对原住民社区及其传统生活方式的影响。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether a company's approach to local community engagement includes proactive programs, such as grievance reporting mechanisms and formal community engagement channels.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司的当地社区沟通方式是否包含主动计划，例如申诉报告机制及正式社区沟通渠道。

sections.title_en: • Company monitors the effectiveness of its human rights policy.
sections.title_cn: • 公司监测人权政策的有效性。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of monitoring to measure the effectiveness of human rights policies, and whether the company commits to targets or reports progress against human rights targets.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：为衡量人权政策有效性而开展监测的程度，以及公司是否承诺人权目标或报告目标进展。

sections.title_en: • Employee training on human rights protection.

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has employee training programs on human rights.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否开展员工人权培训计划。

sections.title_en: • Ethical conduct policy covers contract security providers.
sections.title_cn: • 道德行为政策覆盖外包安保服务商。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether a company has a formal business ethics policy that applies to contract security providers and whether that policy is supported by auditing to ensure compliance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否制定适用于外包安保服务商的正式商业道德政策，并通过审计确保遵守。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether a company has adopted a formal human rights policy and whether that policy is aligned with the United Nations Declaration of Human Rights.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否制定正式人权政策，以及该政策是否与联合国《世界人权宣言》一致。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has a formal policy or informal commitment related to violence and conflict.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否有与暴力及冲突相关的正式政策或非正式承诺。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether a company has a policy to support local suppliers or prioritize purchases that support local communities.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否制定支持本地供应商或优先采用有利于当地社区采购的政策。

blocks.content: Definition: A company's investments in community projects (including local infrastructure, hospitals and education) and philanthropic programs to support local communities.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司对当地基础设施、医院、教育等社区项目的投资，以及支持当地社区的慈善计划。

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management Score, based on the severity and type of controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度及类型，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分。评估采用以下争议类别：

blocks.content: • Human rights controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 人权争议。

blocks.content: • Community impact controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 社区影响争议。

blocks.content: • Indigenous peoples controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 原住民争议。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to Section 3.3.2, Controversies cases, of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.3.2 节“争议案例”。

sections.title_cn: 社区关系风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Community Relations Exposure Score evaluates the company's exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business Segment Exposure Score only. The Business Segment Exposure Score is scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following data sources and methodologies are used in the Exposure Score calculation:

blocks.content: \- $BSE_{CRE,j}$ is the Business Segment Exposure Score for business segment $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BSE_{CRE,j}$ 为业务分部 $j$ 的业务分部风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $w_{Asset,i,j}$ is the weight of business segment j for company i based on the contribution to total company assets.
blocks.content_cn: • $w_{Asset,i,j}$ 为公司 i 的业务分部 j 按其占公司总资产比例确定的权重。

blocks.content_cn: • $n_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务分部数量。

sections.title_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure Score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI ESG Research uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure Score. Each Business Segment Exposure Score is determined as follows:
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI ESG 研究使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部风险敞口得分，各分部得分按以下方式确定：

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $HR_{j}$ is the Human Rights Controversies Score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $HR_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的人权争议得分。

blocks.content: \- $LD_{j}$ is the Land Disturbance Score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $LD_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的土地扰动得分。

blocks.content: \- $WS_{j}$ is the Water Stress Score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $WS_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的水资源压力得分。

blocks.content: \- $TE_{j}$ is the Toxic Emissions Score for business activity $j$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $TE_{j}$ 为业务活动 $j$ 的有毒排放得分。

blocks.content: The Human Rights Controversies Score of a business activity is determined by the percentage of companies involved in a human rights-related controversy assessed as Moderate to Very Severe among all the companies with the same primary business activity. $^{2}$ Refer to Section 3.3.2, Controversies cases, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for details on how the severity of controversy cases is assessed.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的人权争议得分，由具有相同主营业务活动的所有公司中，涉及严重程度为中等至极严重的人权争议的公司比例确定。$^{2}$ 争议严重程度评估详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.3.2 节“争议案例”。

blocks.content: The Land Disturbance Score of a business activity is derived from a qualitative assessment of each business activity and its land-use implications for community relations.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的土地扰动得分，通过定性评估该活动及其土地利用对社区关系的影响确定。

blocks.content: The Water Stress Score of a business activity is derived from a component of the Water Stress Key Issue Score, the Business Segment Exposure Score on that Key Issue of a business activity. For details on how that score is calculated, see the Business Segment Exposure Score section of “MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Water Stress Key Issue.”
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的水资源压力得分，源自水资源压力关键议题得分的一个组成部分，即该活动在该议题上的业务分部风险敞口得分。计算详情参见《MSCI ESG 评级方法论：水资源压力关键议题》的“业务分部风险敞口得分”章节。

blocks.content: The Toxic Emissions Score of a business activity is derived from a component of the Toxic Emissions & Waste Key Issue Score, the Business Segment Exposure Score on that Key Issue of a business activity. For details on how that score is calculated, see the Business Segment Exposure Score section of “MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Toxic Emissions & Waste Key Issue.”
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的有毒排放得分，源自有毒排放与废弃物关键议题得分的一个组成部分，即该活动在该议题上的业务分部风险敞口得分。计算详情参见《MSCI ESG 评级方法论：有毒排放与废弃物关键议题》的“业务分部风险敞口得分”章节。

blocks.content: The Company-Specific Exposure Score is determined by a qualitative assessment of whether a company has major expansion plans under development. If the company has major expansion plans underway, it receives a Company-Specific Exposure Score of 1, otherwise it gets a score of 0.
blocks.content_cn: 公司特定风险敞口得分通过定性评估公司是否正在开发重大扩张计划确定。有正在推进的重大扩张计划，得 1 分；否则得 0 分。
